title: QuoteDesk: request-to-quote assistant for small translation agencies
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: Turns a translation request email and its attachments into a word count, a price from the agency's rate card and a draft reply in minutes, working next to Gmail or Outlook.
hook: "By the time I've opened the PDFs, counted the words and priced it, the client has already accepted someone else's quote."
story:
**Ioana runs a 6-person translation agency in Bucharest.** Every day requests arrive by email: a scanned contract to translate into German, a website in three languages, a certified birth certificate. For each one she opens the attachments, runs a word count (OCR for scans), checks the language pair and deadline, prices it from her rate sheet and writes a reply.

Big agency systems like XTRF cost **$9,000+ a year**, far too much for her. With QuoteDesk, she forwards the email, and within minutes gets the **word count, a price from her rate card and a draft reply**, plus suggested freelancers for the language pair. She stays in Gmail.
whyNow: The professional systems for translation agencies are priced for large firms: XTRF Professional costs $9,000/year and Ultimate $34,000/year, and Plunet uses custom quotes that small shops "rarely qualify for". On G2, Plunet scores only 6.7 for AI text generation. There is no regulatory deadline.
evidence: XTRF Professional costs $9,000/year and Ultimate $34,000/year (vendor page, May 2026) [XTM]
Plunet uses custom quotes that small shops "rarely qualify for" [FitGap]
Plunet scores only 6.7 for AI text generation on G2 [G2]
Projetex costs €2,900 one-time; Protemos is a cheap alternative [Report / MakerStack]
Evidence is indirect only: no time study of quoting at small agencies was found [Report]

solution.title: Connect the inbox
solution.text: Gmail or Outlook connection, or a forwarding address.

solution.title: Read the attachments
solution.text: DOCX and PDF (with OCR) are read and word-counted.

solution.title: Extract the job
solution.text: AI pulls out language pairs, subject, certified or not, and deadline.

solution.title: Price it
solution.text: a rate-card engine prices the job and makes a quote PDF.

solution.title: Draft the reply
solution.text: one click to a ready reply in the agency's tone.

solution.title: Plan the work
solution.text: a simple job board, freelancer roster with language pairs and rates, and a deadline calendar.

must: DOCX and PDF reading with OCR and word counts
AI extraction of job details (languages, subject, certified, deadline)
Simple job board, freelancer roster and deadline calendar

techStack: Small LLM for job extraction and reply drafts

timeline.what: **Validate, no code.** Contact 50 agencies and offer to quote their next 20 incoming requests within 15 minutes, using ChatGPT and a spreadsheet rate card. Measure turnaround and whether faster quotes win more jobs.
Victor builds inbox connection, attachment reading, word counts and AI extraction.
Rate card, quote PDF, draft reply, job board and freelancer roster; billing.
Pilot agencies use it on live requests; track quote speed and win rate.
